name: play-registry
description: UnderSilicon 控制面板的远程游戏仓库（静态站）。面板运行时拉取 registry.json，游戏经面板 gameProxy 同源加载。

scripts.build:site: npm run check:shop-products && node scripts/build-registry.js && node scripts/build-site.js
scripts.test: node --test test/extract.test.js test/gamehost.test.js test/baidu-tongji.test.js test/game-detail.test.js test/auth.test.js test/game-hardware.test.js
